title: Compositions exploring comedy and female sexuality. Two songs entitled Hey Mama and Fallin'
abstract: The realm of standup comedy is largely dominated by male sexual bravado. Female comedians who joke about their sexuality face criticism and slut shaming. I set out to explore how bringing comedy and female sexuality into a musical medium could be used as a subversive tool for gender commentary. I read up on gender theory, analyzed female performance, and wrote songs on a variety of topics including hookup culture, forgiving “the other woman,” and finding fulfilment as a woman in ways other than relationally. I learned that singing can lead an audience to be more forgiving to humor that might be considered abrasive for women in other contexts. I also learned that it’s difficult to overcome the double standards I’ve internalized and to push myself out of my comedic comfort zone. The songs I’ve written are continuously being developed and continue to necessitate the right occasion for performance. The niche of musical comedy relating to femininity has very rich potential for expression and I will continue to compose in this avenue and argue for its importance.
